title: Soft spongy Dhokla from scratch 🟡✨ Gujarati snack #shorts

segments.moment_description: Tempering with mustard seeds and curry leaves

description:
Dhokla — the classic Gujarati steamed snack, made from scratch 🟡✨ Soft, spongy and melt-in-the-mouth, tempered with mustard seeds and curry leaves. Steamed, never fried.

Sweet or spicy — how do you like your dhokla? 👇 Comment below!

🌿 Made with gram flour (besan), yogurt, ginger, green chilli and a light tempering of mustard seeds, curry leaves and sesame — a healthy, protein-rich snack.

Did you know? Dhokla is fermented and steamed instead of fried, which makes it one of India's lightest, most gut-friendly snacks — a Gujarati tea-time favourite for centuries.
